newsitem.title: CANADA: CanWest Global ups semi annual dividend.
newsitem.headline: CanWest Global ups semi annual dividend.

text.p: WINNIPEG, MANITOBA--The Board of Directors of CanWest Global Communications Corp. today declared a dividend in the aggregate amount of 12.5 cents per share on all of the issued shares of the Corporation. The dividend is payable by the Corporation on Tuesday, April 15, 1997 to the holders of record as of the close of business on Tuesday, April 1, 1997. This represents a 150 percent increase over last year's 5 cents semi-annual dividend.

"Traditionally, our semi-annual dividends have been in the range of 1 percent to 1.5 percent of the market value of our stock," said I.H. Asper, O.C., Q.C., CanWest's Chairman and Chief Executive Officer. "In order to maintain this policy, given the recent strong upward movement of our stock, we have raised our semi-annual dividend from 5 cents to 12.5 cents per share. We are pleased to be able to share with our stockholders the extraordinary growth the Company is enjoying."

"We are maintaining our existing dividend policy at this time, and will further review the situation when we declare the year's final dividend after year-end. However, the policy is always open to change based on the Company's results and the need for capital for further growth and expansion," Mr. Asper added.

Under the terms of the Corporation's Dividend Reinvestment Plan, all shareholders have the right to apply their dividends to purchase subordinate voting shares or non-voting shares from the Corporation's treasury at a price equal to 95 percent of the weighted average of the closing prices for the shares on the Toronto Stock Exchange on each of the five trading days immediately preceding the dividend payment date. Shareholders may request a copy of the Dividend Reinvestment Plan from the Dividend Reinvestment Department of Montreal Trust Company of Canada, 200 Portage Avenue, Mezzanine Level, Winnipeg, MB. R3C 3X2, Attention: Dividend Reinvestment Department. Shareholders must make their election to take shares by Tuesday, April 8, 1997, failing which their dividends will be payable in cash.

CanWest Global Communications Corp. (NYSE - CWG and TSE - CGS.S and CGS.A) is a leading international television broadcaster. In Canada, the Company owns and operates the CanWest Global System, Canada's most profitable private sector broadcaster. Internationally, the Company owns substantial economic interests in Australia's Network TEN and New Zealand's TV3. Through these broadcasting operations, CanWest reaches approximately 35.8 million English-speaking people in markets estimated to have generated approximately C$4.4 billion in television advertising spending in 1995.
